notes.title: UPDATE v1.5.0
notes.content:
Hello people.

Now the game has 5 complete worlds and 50 levels for you to complete this adventure. Enjoy and also play the levels made by other people or publish your own. Access the "WORLD" option in the main menu.

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello people.

I bring you 20 new levels to play, and the best. You can now share / publish your levels using the level codes.

WORLD
It is the place for players to post their levels.

Make fun, challenging or complex levels. I sent it to the WORLD, and let's all play!
